backend: CephFS kernel client, Linux 7.0.0-44-generic against Ceph 21.2.0
publication: Exclusive staged create, write, file fsync, close, same-directory rename, directory fsync, syncfs, then fsynced witness outside the Ceph pools
replication: Native RF3/min_size2 across three guest hosts; nine OSDs

kernel_mds_failure.fault: Runtime-mask and SIGKILL the discovered active MDS; await another name/GID, then restore standby
kernel_mds_failure.live_writer: 512 immutable files, 256 KiB by default, 100 ms think time; never paused at injection
kernel_mds_failure.live_reader: Exact byte/hash historical baseline reads through the independent read-only mount
kernel_mds_failure.postcondition: Fresh exact readback on both kernel mounts, preserved library ACKs, all PGs active+clean across three guest hosts and full MON quorum
kernel_mds_failure.failure_policy: Any missing ACK, ambiguity, body mismatch or deadline violation preserves a failed case and its fixture; never reset or reseed it
